label: mcl_core_coal_ore
reference_prompt: Create a close visual reference for coal naturally embedded in the world's ordinary native stone. The host rock should remain the dominant dense gray geological material, interrupted by irregular seams, lenses and fractured pockets of dull black coal following plausible weaknesses and sedimentary traces. Coal surfaces can show subtle carbon luster while crushed edges remain matte and dusty. Avoid evenly sprinkled black dots, painted spots, giant isolated gemstones or turning the whole rock into coal. The ore should feel geologically formed inside stone, with host and carbon structures interacting naturally under pressure.
